One model. Every view. Walk every room.

Walk in, click the view, then use WASD to move, the mouse to look, Shift to run, Space to jump and C to crouch. Walk up the stairs to reach the next floor. ↑/↓ move forward/back; ←/→ turn. Look at a nearby door or window and press F or tap its prompt to open or close it. Esc releases the mouse.

Drag to orbit outside; scroll to zoom. This preview needs no installation or network.
